# regression_refusal

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Refuses promotion when observed regression exceeds the immutable acceptance threshold.

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |

| `authority_ceiling` | `string` | yes | Boundary preventing self-override of refusal. |
